title: The New Male and The New Female
fullTitle: Soul Feast #23: The New Male and The New Female
description: The old male was defined by his ability to protect and provide, while the old female found fulfillment in bearing and raising children . These roles fit neatly within the five-sensory pursuit of external power, but they no longer serve us in the new multi-sensory consciousness .
Together, they seek spiritual partnership—a relationship built on equality and mutual spiritual growth.

The key to embracing these new archetypes is choosing roles based on meaning rather than societal expectations . Whether a male chooses to be a stay-at-home father or a female chooses to lead a multinational corporation, the focus is on fulfillment, contribution, and creating authentic power.
Are you ready to live Beyond the Five Senses? Learn how HERE .
